decisions.reason: This enclosed manual laser marking workstation builds directly on the firm's established marking know-how and service capabilities, and despite being a somewhat more niche manual solution than fully integrated Industry 4.0 systems, the firm has enough related knowledge to refine and support it.

The high-resolution thermal inkjet printer fits the firm's core competence in matching coding technologies to applications and should benefit strongly from its in-house development, production-line integration experience, and broad customer base.

The high-resolution piezo inkjet printer is closely related to the firm's existing identification portfolio and gives it another application-specific technology platform that a large, experienced firm can learn from and improve rather than withdraw quickly.
